member.name: Normalize
member.para: What a greedy left-to-right scan cost. On "Die Cyber-Brutzellen" (2026-08-01) chapter 14's announcement at 7:01:30 was read as 40, and chapters 15 through 29 - every one of them detected, refined and correctly placed - then failed "greater than 40" one after another and were discarded: a 17 h audiobook came out marked as far as 6:21 and no further.

What "the earliest survives" costs when something plants a phantom first. "Atlan" (build 392, 2026-08-24): a hallucinated second match on chapter 5's announcement was marked as chapter 6 at 2:28:25.26, and when Re-probe later placed the real chapter 6 at 2:47:23.42 the filter had two marks numbered 6 to choose between and kept the earlier one - the phantom. The tie-break is not the defect (it is what keeps an in-text mention from displacing a real chapter, and nothing in this filter can tell the two apart), which is why the fix was to settle the collision before the filter ever sees it rather than to change how it resolves ties.
